title: Dave's level
kicker: Power and builds · level up and power
hook: **Dave’s level** is the main power line for your summoner — endless, with no cap. Play raises it; Vision chapters may drip complexity by it later.

blindSpots.meaning: Your summoner’s level — Crazy Dave’s power line — not a lawn plant’s XP bar alone.
There is no soft ceiling where grinding stops mattering by design. New worlds raise prestige; they do not wipe who you are.
Spendable power you earn as Dave grows — see [free-build aptitudes](aptitudes).
Vision drip by Dave level — not the live rail today. See [unlock chapters](unlock-chapters).

alsoTrue: Specimens and type lines also grow from work they did — see [type and specimen XP](type-specimen-xp).
HUD and Chronicle show progression; exact curves live in balance data.

sections.title: What it is
paras: The spine of the power loop: play → Dave levels → spend into builds.
No designed hard stop where more play stops counting.

sections.title: How you use it
steps: Play lawn, expeditions, and map work that feed progression.
Watch Dave’s level on the HUD / Chronicle.
Spend aptitude points as you earn them — there is no soft ceiling telling you to stop.

sections.title: What it is not
paras: It is not the live unlock table for the rail (that is play beats).
It is not specimen XP — individuals grow on their own track too.

doSteps: Finish a lawn match or other play that pays experience.
Find Dave’s level on the HUD or Chronicle.
If you have aptitude points, open builds and spend at least one.
doNote: Stop when “no cap” is clear. Next: [type and specimen XP](type-specimen-xp).

mixUps.q: Is there a max Dave level?
mixUps.a: No designed cap. Endless grind is the rule.

mixUps.q: Does a new world reset Dave?
mixUps.a: You keep who you are across worlds — see [New world](new-world-prestige).
Dave chapters are Vision. Relics open on the live item beat.

mixUps.q: Is Dave’s level the same as a demon’s level?
mixUps.a: No. Demons have specimen XP; Dave is the summoner line.
